mu_name_from: OpenMU VersionSeasonSix/Items/Orbs.cs:57, CreateOrb(21, SkillNumber...) -- "Scroll of Fire Burst" (OpenMU spells it "FireBurst"). MuMain loads all five Dark Lord scrolls on one model, Data/Item/SkillScroll (ZzzOpenData.cpp:1061-1065).
why_this_one:
The only way the Dark Lord learns Fire Burst (docs/plans/dark-lord-spells/fire-burst.md). Group 12 number 26 is ours: MU's 21 is our Orb of Multi-Shot. 23, 24 and 26 were kept free for the Dark Lord's scrolls (docs/plans/dark-lord-spells/fire-burst.md section 6).

Drop only: Marlon's quest is a level 1-30 one, far under its 74 (docs/plans/dark-lord-spells/fire-burst.md section 7.5). No shop sells it, as in MU (the user, 2026-10-25: MU drops and the plan's quests).

stats.note: A Dark Lord scroll's row: OpenMU's CreateOrb shape -- 1 x 2, durability one, dropped by monsters.
stats.classes_from: The Dark Lord's alone (OpenMU's CreateOrb(..., DarkLord); the skill is his, sim::skillFor).
stats.requires_note: Level 74, MU's (the skill row's needLevel in sim/skills.cpp, and the skill block below). The energy is MU's raw 20 (OpenMU VersionSeasonSix/Items/Orbs.cs:57), which sim::asks scales as WebZen does, 20 + 20 x 74 x 4 / 100 = 79, the number the skill block asks.

skill.note: What the scroll teaches. Read once and gone.
skill.name: Fire Burst
skill.tells: Three fires flung at one body up to six tiles off; everything within three tiles of it burns half a second later. His energy multiplies it.
skill.tells_from: The skill's own line in sim/skills.cpp, kept letter for letter.
skill.energy_from: MU's raw 20 through WebZen's skill formula (MagicDamage.cpp:663-677), 20 + 20 x 74 x 4 / 100 = 79; docs/plans/dark-lord-spells/fire-burst.md.
skill.level_from: MU's 74, as on the skill's row (sim/skills.cpp needLevel).

profile_note: As the books and the orbs: a small object in the bag and on the ground.
mesh_from: content/items/misc/ScrollFireBurst.obj is MuMain's Data/Item/skillScroll.bmd (MuExtract export-obj): three meshes, the scroll itself (dkScroll, 74 triangles) and two flat cards over it (dkScroll_R and dkScroll2_R, 2 each). SkillScroll01-04.bmd beside it are other files that nothing loads for these rows. The other four scrolls borrow this one's mesh.
sheet_from: Data/Item/dkScroll.OZJ, dkScroll_R.OZJ and dkScroll2_R.OZJ (64x64 each) from MuMain, decoded by pipeline/decode_texture.py.
sheet_note: dkScroll: a grey cloth sheet framed in gold between two copper rollers. dkScroll_R: four rows of blue runes on black. dkScroll2_R: a blue lion's head on black.
material_note: cloth: most of the one painted island is the grey sheet; the gold frame and the rollers are painted on it. The two _R cards are glows and take no material.
cutout_from: No alpha in any of the three .OZJ.
glow_note: ZzzObject.cpp:9745-9757: mesh 0 drawn plain; mesh 1 (the runes) RENDER_BRIGHT at BlendMeshLight = sin(WorldTime*0.001)*0.5 + 0.5, and mesh 2 (the lion) RENDER_BRIGHT at 1 minus that -- the two breathing against each other. Pulse [0.5, 0.5] and [-0.5, 0.5] at the slow rate (WorldTime*0.001). Nothing else of MuMain's draws on these rows: no held light, no shine colour.
